# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("R/setup.R")
library(gtsummary) # Essential for Table 1 generation
library(ggstats)   # Helper for gtsummary plots (optional)

# Load the finalized dataset from the validation step
# Note: Ensure this file was saved at the end of 02_data-validation.qmd
gic_validated <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "gic_validated.rds"))
```

# Baseline Characteristics
```{r}
#| label: tbl-baseline
#| tbl-cap: "Table 1: Baseline Patient Characteristics by HIV Status"

gic_validated |> 
  select(
    # Demographics
    sex, residence, 
    height_0, weight_0, bmi_0,
    
    # Clinical
    cancer_site, cancer_stage, histology,
    
    # Comorbidities (Grouped)
    comorbid_htn, comorbid_dm, comorbid_tb, 
    
    # Stratification Variable
    hiv_status
  ) |> 
  tbl_summary(
    by = hiv_status,                # Split column
    missing = "ifany",              # Show missing counts if they exist
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",        # Mean (SD) for numerics
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"           # N (%) for factors
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1   # 1 decimal place for means
  ) |> 
  add_p() |>                        # Add p-value for differences
  add_overall() |>                  # Add "Total" column
  bold_labels() |> 
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Patient Characteristics**")
```
